decisions.reason: Selecting Google Workspace for the campaign mailbox does not change the domain's web-forwarding addresses or behavior.
The email-provider selection does not change the provisioned domain name, registrar, or domain-provisioning requirement.
The source confirms the mailbox provider but does not change the requirement to warm up the new domain or establish provider-specific warm-up semantics.
Choosing Google Workspace for the campaign mailbox does not alter the isolated-test-account or production-data protection policies.
The source does not change MeetAlfred, the email campaign channel, or automated execution; it only identifies the separate mailbox provider.
Google Workspace selection for the campaign mailbox does not change MeetAlfred account setup or its subscription plan.
The campaign mailbox provider does not change Apollo as the contact-enrichment provider or the enrichment data and mode.
The campaign email-account provider has no necessary effect on the separate automated LinkedIn campaign requirement.
The mention of Google refers to Google Workspace for the campaign mailbox, not Apollo configuration or its Chrome extension.
The mailbox-provider selection does not change silent-lead recirculation, MeetAlfred export, or campaign-cleanup behavior.
Google Workspace selection does not change the Zapier account setup, subscription plan, or add-on choice.
Selecting a mailbox provider does not change the requirement to keep the MeetAlfred integration connected during ongoing campaign work.
